name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 50
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26d. Calls, furthermore, for the creation of additional and targeted EU funding for the expansion and requalification of public housing, the fight against speculation and the defence of the right to decent and affordable housing for all;
